messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: P1 - inference-hotcell backlog exceeds threshold (120k). Autoscaler failing to provision. Pager: #eng-oncall. Link: https://p.d/INC-2026-045

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty -> INC-2026-045 created, responders: ash, maria, sam. Notify: @eng-oncall

ash: ack. I'm taking the page and jumping in. Checking autoscaler logs and provisioning errors now.

maria: I see a ton of 429/403 from the cloud API while autoscaler was trying to create instances. Might be quota or provider-side throttling.

sam: looking up project quotas now. Will confirm if we've hit a CPU/VM limit.

ash: snippet from autoscaler logs: `ERROR provisioner: request failed: 403 QuotaExceeded: compute.googleapis.com CPUs` — repeated in last 5m. KV-cache warmup is triggering many hotcell spinups.

ben: any customer-facing failures?

ash: yes, a surge of queue backlog caused short-lived 503s when workers couldn't keep up. Roughly ~2% of requests returned 503s over the last 12m, concentrated on smaller shared-pool tenants.

maria: I've opened emergency quota request with cloud support (ticket #123456). Also preparing a manual path: can we move some hot tenants to our reserved/dedicated pool temporarily?

sam: GCP quota dashboard shows CPUs used == 1000/1000 for project redwood-shared-1. No spare cores. Request submitted for +200 CPUs emergency increase. ETA from support: ~10-15m.

ash: while we wait, I'll start a manual spin-up using our reserved quota in the dedicated-hotcells project and update routing. Command I'll run: 
```
gcloud compute instances create hotcell-ded-1 --project=dedicated-hotcells --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=n1-highcpu-16 --image=... --metadata=role=hotcell
```

maria: started creation of 6 dedicated nodes and kicked off targeted KV-cache warmup for the top prefixes: `kvcache-warmup --prefix=hot-* --concurrency=8`.

ash: initiating traffic re-route: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% to dedicated-hotcells for tenants matching tag `hot-tenant`. Applying runtime shim: `route:dedicated-hotcells` (canary roll).

pagerduty-bot: ash acknowledged INC-2026-045 at 4501234580

sam: cloud support replied: emergency quota increase approved for +200 CPUs, provisioning in progress (ETA ~12m).

maria: dedicated pool nodes came up clean for 6 nodes; warmup progressing. Queue backlog dropping: 120k -> 60k in 10m after initial reroute/warmup.

ben: +1 on postmortem action items: add autoscaler fallback to reserved pools on provider quota failures; emit quota-health metric to alert earlier.

ash: noted. I'll file follow-up RFC and add a short-term circuit that routes to dedicated pools when autoscaler returns 403/429 on provision attempts.

maria: monitoring shows 503 rate back to baseline, latency improving. Will keep warmup running until token cache rehydrates.

ash: queue length now ~12k, steady. No new 503 spikes for 20m. Keeping the rota until stable for 30m.

incident-bot: INC-2026-045 status update: mitigated -> stable. Last observed queue = 12k; 503 rate at baseline. Incident resolved by manual reroute + emergency quota + dedicated pool spin-up.

sam: closing PD incident. Follow-ups: quota increase permanent request, autoscaler fallback behavior, quota-health dashboard, postmortem write-up. I'll own the postmortem.

ash: thanks team.

ben: adding note to backlog: add a simulated quota-failure test in chaos engineering suite. :memo:
